mapper.select: SELECT t.template_id FROM excel_upload_templates t WHERE t.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND t.template_version = 'v1.0' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND t.effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY t.effective_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT f.uploader_user_id AS "uploaderUserId", f.validation_status AS "validationStatus" FROM excel_upload_files f WHERE f.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE excel_upload_files SET validation_status = 'REJECTED' WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = #{teacherId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT h.upload_id AS "uploadId", f.original_file_name AS "originalFileName", f.uploader_user_id AS "uploaderUserId", h.total_count AS "totalCount", h.success_count AS "successCount", h.error_count AS "errorCount", h.excluded_count AS "excludedCount", h.saved_count AS "savedCount", h.processing_time_millis AS "processingTimeMillis", h.processed_at AS "processedAt" FROM excel_upload_histories h JOIN excel_upload_files f ON f.upload_id = h.upload_id WHERE f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' AND h.status != 'DELETED' AND (#{admin} = TRUE OR f.uploader_user_id = #{userId}) AND f.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND f.original_file_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ORDER BY h.processed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM excel_upload_histories h JOIN excel_upload_files f ON f.upload_id = h.upload_id WHERE f.business_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' AND h.status != 'DELETED' AND (#{admin} = TRUE OR f.uploader_user_id = #{userId}) AND f.upload_id = #{uploadId} AND f.original_file_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
